svg.aria-label: FIFO and delay scheduling of the same 18 requests on 3 workers that each hold one renderer. FIFO switches renderers 17 times, delay scheduling 4 times; the average response drops from 223 ms to 128 ms. With one worker that keeps getting requests for its renderer, request #2 for another style waits 1015 ms, then the 1 s cap takes it.

svg.text: a free worker takes the oldest request
a free worker takes, in order:
1 worker holds liberty @1x; its requests arrive every 60 ms, faster than it renders them
the oldest request has waited 1 s or more: take it
the queue has requests for a renderer this worker holds: take the oldest of them
the oldest request has waited the switch cost or more, or this worker holds no renderer: take it
else wait, up to the switch cost
